history.summary: A new-launch 4+study (Clavon/Clement Canopy-area type product, TOP 2027) in D05 priced at $3.48M / $2,309 psf, marketed on Nan Hua Primary proximity. The quantum and PSF are full new-launch pricing on a leasehold large unit, with weak score (409) and no project transaction history attached.
history.rating_rationale: $3.48M for a 99-yr leasehold 4BR is well above the liquid $1.8-2.5M band — exit pool is thin. $2,309 psf is top-of-market new-launch pricing on a large unit, so the appreciation runway is already largely priced in. 1km to Nan Hua appeals to a narrow own-stay family buyer, not an investment thesis; 12-min walk to MRT removes the transit premium. score_1000 = 409 (below market-typical).
